Jharkhand Weather : 20 navanbar se chakravat 'akvan' ki ho rahi jharkhand men entri, badlega mausam
Jharkhand men agle char dinon tak mausam shushk rahne ka anuman hai. is dauran rajdhani ranchi samet rajy ke adhikansh jilon men subah ke samay kohra chhaya rahega. halanki din charhne ke sath aasman saph hoga aur dhup khilne se logon ko rahat milegi. subah aur rat ke tapman men giravat ke karan thand ka ehsas dhire-dhire barhega.
